name: Yamaoka Ami
source:
Speciality: liberal arts subjects in general
Weakness: interpersonal relationships
Hobbies: the occult, black magic

[url=/c82067]Kouji[/url]'s junior. An acquaintance of [url=/c82068]Minamoto Yuuko[/url] through whom she got to know Kouji. She has a gloomy and easily dejected personality, and feels strongly alienated from others. She hasn't gotten along with her parents and her siblings ever since she was a child, or rather, they do not involve themselves with her. She got interested in the occult and black magic after entering middle school and has been leading a life of indulging into them. Even the reason she wanted to meet Kouji was that he is said to have seen a ghost in his childhood. She respects Yuuko and wants to become like her. She likes shoujo manga and reggae music.

[Translated from [url=https://www.saibunkan.co.jp/scramble/jin/rena/ami.html]Scramble HOUSE's official website[/url]]
